abstract: We examine how the shapes of utility functions, particularly risk attitudes, influence Nash bargaining outcomes, thereby challenging the conventional assumption of risk neutrality. Our comparative static analysis reveals several key insights. (1) Changes in Pie Size: Increasing Absolute Risk Aversion (IARA) introduces an “equality bias,” which elucidates the fair distributions observed in unstructured bargaining experiments by emphasizing the role of participants’ risk attitudes. (2) Changes in Disagreement Point: IARA also results in low sensitivity, referred to as “insensitivity bias,” which contests the interpretation proposed by Anbarci and Feltovich (2013) by showing that concave IARA utility functions can adequately explain this insensitivity. These equality bias and insensitivity bias are closely interconnected phenomena. We propose a novel theoretical framework that elucidates the diverse outcomes of experimental bargaining through the lens of fundamental risk attitudes.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了效用函数形状，特别是风险态度，如何影响纳什谈判结果，从而挑战了风险中性的传统假设。我们的比较静态分析揭示了几个关键见解。(1) 馅饼大小的变化：递增绝对风险厌恶（IARA）引入了“平等偏见”，这通过强调参与者风险态度的作用，阐明了非结构化谈判实验中观察到的公平分配。(2) 分歧点的变化：IARA还导致低敏感性，称为“不敏感偏见”，这通过展示凹形IARA效用函数能够充分解释这种不敏感性，对Anbarci和Feltovich（2013）提出的解释提出了质疑。这些平等偏见和不敏感偏见是紧密相连的现象。我们提出了一种新颖的理论框架，通过基本风险态度的视角阐明了实验性谈判的多样化结果。
title: Comparative statics of Nash bargaining solution: Equality and insensitivity biases
title_zh: 纳什谈判解的比较静态分析：平等与不敏感偏差

abstract: We develop a real options model with finite-maturity debt to examine how rollover risk shapes the relative effectiveness of tax cuts and investment subsidies. Shorter debt maturity amplifies rollover risk, which strengthens the effectiveness of tax cuts while weakening that of investment subsidies. Under budget neutrality, tax cuts are always optimal. Under a net-subsidy regime, the optimal instrument is maturity-dependent: subsidies are optimal at long maturities, while as maturity shortens, a threshold tax rate emerges above which tax cuts are optimal and below which subsidies remain optimal. When maturity is sufficiently short, tax cuts dominate across all tax rates.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个包含有限期限债务的实物期权模型，以考察滚动风险如何影响减税与投资补贴的相对有效性。较短的债务期限会放大滚动风险，从而增强减税的效果，同时削弱投资补贴的作用。在预算中性条件下，减税始终是最优选择。在净补贴机制下，最优工具取决于债务期限：在长期限下，补贴为最优；随着期限缩短，会出现一个税率阈值，高于该阈值时减税为最优，低于该阈值时补贴仍为最优。当期限足够短时，减税在所有税率水平下均占优。
title: Policy incentives, firm investment, and debt rollover risk
title_zh: 政策激励、企业投资与债务展期风险

abstract: AI coding agents, general purpose assistants that write and execute code, make empirical specification search fast and cheap, but they also widen hidden researcher degrees of freedom. This paper adapts an open-source agent-loop architecture to an empirical economics workflow and adds a post-search holdout evaluation. In a forecast-combination illustration, independent agent searches find methods that improve on benchmarks from the original study. Logged search and holdout evaluation together make adaptive specification search more transparent and help distinguish robust improvements from sample-specific discoveries.
abstract_zh: AI编码代理，即编写并执行代码的通用助手，使得实证规格搜索变得快速且成本低廉，但同时也扩大了研究者隐藏的自由度。本文将开源代理循环架构适配至实证经济学工作流程，并增设搜索后保留样本评估环节。在预测组合的示例中，独立代理搜索发现的方法优于原始研究中的基准方法。结合日志记录的搜索过程与保留样本评估，使自适应规格搜索更加透明，并有助于区分稳健改进与样本特定发现。
title: An auditable AI agent loop for empirical economics: A case study in forecast combination
title_zh: 可审计的人工智能代理循环在实证经济学中的应用：预测组合的案例研究

abstract: Social media has created new, highly competitive markets for attention. But to what extent does attention on social media generate tangible economic returns and how are these returns characterized? Using a daily dataset of Twitter activity and campaign contributions for US Members of Congress (2019-2020), we show that attention on Twitter, as measured by likes, increases small donations. However, the effect is highly skewed: only a few members benefit substantially, consistent with a winner-takes-all market. These results are confirmed using a geography-based causal design tracking donation patterns across counties, showing that the increase in donations from attention on Twitter comes disproportionately from high Twitter usage areas.
abstract_zh: 社交媒体催生了新的、竞争激烈的注意力市场。然而，社交媒体上的注意力在多大程度上能转化为切实的经济回报，这些回报又具有怎样的特征？利用美国国会议员（2019-2020年）的推特活动与竞选捐款的日度数据集，我们表明，推特上的注意力（以点赞量衡量）会增加小额捐款。然而，这种效应高度偏斜：仅有少数议员获得显著收益，这与赢家通吃的市场特征相符。这些结果通过一项基于地理的因果设计得到证实，该设计追踪了各县的捐款模式，显示推特注意力带来的捐款增长不成比例地来自高推特使用率地区。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: The Returns to Viral Media: The Case of US Campaign Contributions,
title_zh: 病毒媒体的回报：美国竞选捐款的案例

abstract: Joint household decision-making becomes more common as economies develop. Can external intervention advance this transition? We study this question in the context of female employment in India. We randomized which spouse was given a ticket enabling enrollment in a women’s weaving job, and cross-randomized the other to receive no information about the ticket, information, or information and discussion with their spouse. Academic and local experts predict information and discussion should raise enrollment. Instead, information had no effect, and discussion reduced enrollment by 50%. We do not find an effect of giving the wife the job ticket rather than the husband. Our results show that interventions toward joint decision-making about an opportunity can lower take-up.
abstract_zh: 随着经济的发展，家庭联合决策变得越来越普遍。外部干预能否推动这一转变？我们在印度女性就业的背景下研究这一问题。我们随机分配了哪一方配偶获得一张可报名参加女性织布工作的票，并交叉随机分配另一方配偶分别处于三种情况：未获知票的信息、获知信息、或获知信息并与配偶讨论。学术专家和当地专家预测，信息与讨论应能提高报名率。然而，信息并未产生效果，而讨论则使报名率降低了50%。我们未发现将工作票给予妻子而非丈夫会产生影响。我们的结果表明，针对机会的联合决策干预措施可能降低参与率。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Coupling Labor Supply Decisions: An Experiment in India,
title_zh: 印度劳动力供给决策的耦合：一项实验研究

abstract: University access has significantly expanded in OECD countries, and further growth figures prominently in political agendas. We study possible consequences of historical and future expansions in a stochastic, general equilibrium Roy model where tertiary educational attainment is determined by cognitive ability and socioeconomic disadvantage. In our analysis, individual productivity depends not only on education but also directly on cognitive ability. The expansion of university access in the U.K. that started in the 1960s provides an ideal case study to draw lessons for the future. We find that this expansion led to the selection into college of progressively less talented students from advantaged backgrounds. Appropriate counterfactual policies existed that would have achieved the dual goal of increasing college graduates’ cognitive ability while improving tertiary education opportunities for the disadvantaged.
abstract_zh: 在OECD国家，大学入学机会已显著扩大，且进一步增长在政治议程中占据突出位置。我们研究历史和未来扩张在随机、一般均衡罗伊模型中的可能后果，其中高等教育成就由认知能力和社会经济劣势决定。在我们的分析中，个体生产力不仅取决于教育，还直接取决于认知能力。英国自20世纪60年代开始的大学入学扩张为未来提供了理想案例研究。我们发现，这一扩张导致来自优势背景的学生中，能力逐渐较低者被选拔进入大学。存在适当的反事实政策，本可实现增加大学毕业生认知能力与改善弱势群体高等教育机会的双重目标。
title: College, Cognitive Ability, and Socioeconomic Disadvantage: Policy Lessons from the U.K. in 1960–2004
title_zh: 大学、认知能力与社会经济劣势：1960—2004年英国的政策启示

abstract: We study the effect of reducing welfare assistance on migrants’ long-term integration in Australia. The reform applied to primary carers of children, delaying welfare benefit eligibility during their first two years in the country. Importantly, the reform was announced after migrants had arrived in Australia. Using a Regression Discontinuity Design and two decades of administrative welfare data, we find that the reform led to a significant and persistent reduction in overall welfare receipt up to 21 years after arrival, with effects that are particularly pronounced among migrants from more disadvantaged backgrounds. Increases in labour income were insufficient to offset the reduction in welfare benefits, and suggestive evidence indicates that migrants face a trade-off between higher-paying jobs and employment stability.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了减少福利援助对澳大利亚移民长期融入的影响。该改革针对儿童的主要照顾者，将他们在该国头两年的福利资格获取时间推迟。重要的是，这项改革是在移民抵达澳大利亚之后才宣布的。利用断点回归设计及二十年的行政福利数据，我们发现该改革导致移民在抵达后长达21年的总体福利领取显著且持续减少，这一效应在来自更弱势背景的移民中尤为明显。劳动收入的增加不足以弥补福利削减带来的损失，且初步证据表明，移民面临高薪工作与就业稳定性之间的权衡。
title: Welfare reform and migrants’ long-term labor market integration
title_zh: 福利改革与移民的长期劳动力市场融入

abstract: Foreign direct investment (FDI) in agriculture—particularly through large-scale land acquisitions—has become increasingly common across Africa. While existing studies have focused on the economic and environmental implications of these investments, their political effects remain underexplored. This study investigates how foreign land acquisitions shape citizens’ satisfaction with democracy in African democracies. By integrating spatial data from the Land Matrix with geo-referenced Afrobarometer survey responses (2002–2018), this study employs a difference-in-differences design to identify the causal impact of proximity to operational land deals. The findings suggest that foreign land acquisitions reduce democratic satisfaction through instrumental and intrinsic pathways. However, when local communities are meaningfully consulted, these negative effects are significantly mitigated. The results underscore that substantive consultation with local communities is a prerequisite for aligning foreign investment with sustainable development and inclusive growth, thereby offering new insights into how land-based FDI shapes democratic legitimacy in developing countries.
abstract_zh: 农业领域的外国直接投资（FDI）——尤其是通过大规模土地收购——在非洲日益普遍。尽管现有研究聚焦于这些投资的经济与环境影响，但其政治效应仍未得到充分探讨。本研究探讨外国土地收购如何影响非洲民主国家公民对民主的满意度。通过将Land Matrix的空间数据与地理参照的Afrobarometer调查数据（2002-2018年）相结合，本研究采用双重差分设计来识别接近运营中土地交易的因果影响。研究结果表明，外国土地收购通过工具性和内在性路径降低了民主满意度。然而，当地方社区被有意义地征询意见时，这些负面影响显著减弱。研究结果强调，与地方社区进行实质性磋商是将外国投资与可持续发展和包容性增长相结合的前提，从而为土地型外国直接投资如何塑造发展中国家的民主合法性提供了新的见解。
title: Sowing discontent: Foreign land acquisitions and satisfaction with democracy in Africa
title_zh: 播种不满：外国土地收购与非洲民主满意度

abstract: E-commerce platforms increasingly introduce private-label products that compete with green manufacturers’ products, while choosing among platform in-house production, outsourcing to green manufacturers, and outsourcing to OEM manufacturers. This study develops a game-theoretic model to examine how selling modes and production strategies affect green technology investment, platform–manufacturer cooperation, and private-label production choices, considering private-label market size, competition intensity, and consumer green preferences. Results show that when private-label market size exceeds a critical threshold, platform in-house production becomes optimal under both reselling and agency selling, with a lower threshold under reselling. As competition intensifies, green manufacturers reduce green technology investment. The platform adjusts its production strategy according to the cost difference between in-house production and outsourcing. From a supply chain perspective, agency selling achieves Pareto improvement over reselling within intermediate commission-rate ranges when no private label is introduced, production is in-house, or production is outsourced to green manufacturers. However, under outsourcing to OEM manufacturers, reselling achieves a win–win outcome over agency selling within an intermediate commission-rate range. KEYWORDS: Platform sales mode private-label production mode green manufacturer JEL CLASSIFICATION: L81 L13 Q56
abstract_zh: 电商平台日益引入自有品牌产品，与绿色制造商的产品形成竞争，同时需在平台自产、外包给绿色制造商及外包给OEM制造商之间做出选择。本研究构建博弈论模型，考察销售模式与生产策略如何影响绿色技术投资、平台与制造商合作及自有品牌生产选择，并考虑自有品牌市场规模、竞争强度及消费者绿色偏好等因素。研究结果表明，当自有品牌市场规模超过临界阈值时，平台自产在转售模式和代理销售模式下均为最优选择，且转售模式下的阈值更低。随着竞争加剧，绿色制造商减少绿色技术投资。平台根据自产与外包之间的成本差异调整其生产策略。从供应链视角看，在不引入自有品牌、采用自产或外包给绿色制造商的情况下，代理销售在中等佣金率区间内相对于转售模式实现帕累托改进。然而，在外包给OEM制造商的情形下，转售模式在中等佣金率区间内相对于代理销售实现双赢结果。关键词：平台销售模式；自有品牌生产模式；绿色制造商 JEL分类：L81 L13 Q56
china_relevance_reason: 论文为博弈论模型研究，未明确使用中国数据、制度背景或政策背景，研究对象为一般性电商平台与制造商，不特指中国情境。
title: Platform private-label production modes and manufacturer sales strategy choices under green product competition
title_zh: 绿色产品竞争下平台自有品牌生产模式与制造商销售策略选择

abstract: This study estimates the effects of an employment programme for disadvantaged unemployed individuals. The programme emphasized on‐the‐job training and contracting the unemployed for a few paid weekly work hours as a stepping stone into the labour market. Evaluated through a randomized controlled trial with 3,727 participants, the programme was found to accelerate transitions into part‐time work. Contrary to its intention, it permanently increased the share of participants receiving disability pensions among most disadvantaged groups. To explain this finding, we suggest that training, while enhancing productivity for some, simultaneously provided information of employability used in the assessment of disability pension eligibility.
abstract_zh: 本研究评估了一项针对弱势失业者的就业计划的效果。该计划强调在职培训，并安排失业者每周从事数小时的有偿工作，作为进入劳动力市场的跳板。通过一项包含3，727名参与者的随机对照试验评估，发现该计划加速了向兼职工作的转变。与预期相反，它在大多数最弱势群体中永久性地提高了领取残疾抚恤金的参与者比例。为解释这一发现，我们认为培训在提升部分人生产力的同时，也提供了用于评估残疾抚恤金资格的可就业性信息。
title: Stepping stone or exit path: experimental evidence on training the long‐term unemployed
title_zh: 垫脚石还是退出通道：针对长期失业者培训的实验证据

abstract: We consider two-stage parallel contests with a finite set of agents, as well as a finite set of heterogeneous contests with varying winning prizes. In the first stage, each agent simultaneously chooses in which contest he wants to compete, and in the second stage, the agents who chose the same contest compete against each other in a contest for a single prize. We first assume a general Tullock contest success function with nonlinear cost functions, and then we present an algorithm that converges to equilibrium, namely, the algorithm organizes the allocation of homogeneous or heterogeneous agents of two types, each with a different cost of effort, among the contests until no agent wishes to change his current contest. Later, we assume the Tullock contest success function with linear cost functions, and we show that for homogeneous agents, our model and a potential game are equivalent, allowing us to explicitly characterize the subgame perfect equilibrium with pure strategies.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑一个包含有限数量参与者的两阶段并行竞赛模型，以及一系列奖品各异的异质性竞赛。在第一阶段，每位参与者同时选择想要参加的竞赛；在第二阶段，选择同一竞赛的参与者们为争夺单一奖品而相互竞争。我们首先假设采用具有非线性成本函数的通用Tullock竞赛成功函数，随后提出一种收敛至均衡的算法，即该算法组织同质或异质的两类参与者（每类具有不同的努力成本）在竞赛间进行分配，直至没有参与者希望更换其当前竞赛。接着，我们假设采用具有线性成本函数的Tullock竞赛成功函数，并证明对于同质参与者，我们的模型与一个势博弈等价，从而能够明确刻画纯策略下的子博弈完美均衡。
title: An algorithmic analysis of parallel contests
title_zh: 并行竞赛的算法分析

abstract: The slow adoption of wagon transport in the Andes is a puzzle. We examine it by developing a threshold technology-adoption model calibrated using human and mule energy consumption and unique historical data from a human trail and the first wagon road in the Andes. Model predictions align with historical social choices. Pre-Columbians selected a straight, steep, short route for human porters to reduce energy costs, while the Spanish used it with mule packs. Late nineteenth-century transport demand growth surpassed the model’s threshold and contributed to construction of the zigzagging, gentle, long wagon road route, as well as incentives to build state capacity.
abstract_zh: 安第斯地区马车运输的缓慢采用是一个谜团。我们通过构建一个阈值技术采纳模型来探究此问题，该模型利用人力和骡马能量消耗数据以及来自安第斯地区一条人行小道和首条马车道路的独特历史数据进行校准。模型预测与历史上的社会选择相吻合。前哥伦布时期的人们选择了一条笔直、陡峭且路程较短的人行路线，以降低人力搬运者的能量成本，而西班牙人则利用此路线进行骡马驮运。19世纪末，运输需求的增长超过了模型的阈值，这不仅促进了蜿蜒平缓的长距离马车道路的建设，也激发了构建国家能力的动力。
title: Why Was the Wheel (Not) Used in the Andes? A Hypothesis Explaining the Slow Adoption of Wagon Transport and Evidence from Nineteenth-Century Colombia
title_zh: 为何安第斯山脉（未）使用轮子？——解释货车运输缓慢采用的一个假说及来自十九世纪哥伦比亚的证据

abstract: We study how anti-fascist opposition during Mussolini’s dictatorship affects post-war support for right-wing parties in Italy. We construct a measure of anti-fascism from the universe of recorded opponents, and use newly digitized historical data to resolve simultaneity between the supply of opposition and the demand for repression, leveraging the random assignment of judges to the Special Tribunal for the Defense of the State. Stronger local opposition leads to weaker support for right-wing parties decades later. Our model generates predictions about underlying mechanisms, tested using data on collective memorialization and parental voting behavior. The main driver is social transmission of political preferences.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了墨索里尼独裁时期反法西斯反对派如何影响战后意大利对右翼政党的支持。我们根据所有记录在案的反对者构建了一个反法西斯主义衡量指标，并利用新近数字化的历史数据，通过随机分配法官至国家防御特别法庭来解决反对派供给与镇压需求之间的同时性问题。地方反对力量越强，数十年后对右翼政党的支持就越弱。我们的模型生成了关于潜在机制的预测，并通过集体纪念活动和父母投票行为的数据进行了检验。主要驱动因素是政治偏好的社会传递。
title: Historical Anti-Fascism and Right-Wing Voting in Italy
title_zh: 意大利历史上的反法西斯主义与右翼投票

abstract: The role of Common Pool natural Resources (CPRs) such as forests, grasslands, rivers, lakes, wetlands and oceans in rural economies has been much debated in the literature, often on the basis of micro-level or provincial-scale analyses and focusing on a single type of CPR, typically forests. This study draws on data from 6,509 households across fifteen regions in nine low and middle-income countries covering Africa, Asia, and Latin America that also cover a diverse set of CPRs, including forests, savannas, grasslands, mangroves and inland and marine fisheries. We estimate the contribution of CPR-based income to total household income and vis-a-vis the poverty line across income classes, and analyse the correlates of CPR-based income and the relationship between CPR income and income inequality within rural settlements. Our results highlight three important aspects of the CPR-rural income relationship. First, they confirm that CPR-based income makes up a significant portion of the income of the rural poor even across diverse geographies and CPRs. Households below the World Bank $1.9 per capita per day poverty line derive on average one fourth of their household income from CPRs. Second, the regression results highlight the importance of physical resource abundance and social accessibility, household demography, the regional demographic/market context, and most importantly the complementary productive assets owned by households in deriving income from CPRs. Third, there is a distinct correlation between the broad nature of CPR harvest technologies and income-inequality: when the harvest technology is capital-intensive, richer households derive more monetary benefit from CPRs, not only in absolute terms but also in terms of share in household income, leading to a situation where such CPRs exacerbate inequality within settlements. Our results highlight the importance of integrating a diversity of CPRs and CPR availability, access and technological context into CPR studies. They also highlight the need for pro-poor policies that go beyond securing resource access and include support for the poor to access technologies and markets.
abstract_zh: 诸如森林、草地、河流、湖泊、湿地和海洋等公共池资源（CPRs）在农村经济中的作用，在文献中一直备受争议，这些讨论往往基于微观层面或省级尺度的分析，并聚焦于单一类型的CPR，尤其是森林。本研究利用来自非洲、亚洲和拉丁美洲九个中低收入国家十五个地区的6509户家庭数据，这些数据覆盖了包括森林、稀树草原、草地、红树林以及内陆和海洋渔业在内的多种CPR类型。我们估算了基于CPR的收入对家庭总收入的贡献，并对照贫困线分析了不同收入阶层的情况，同时探讨了CPR收入的相关因素以及CPR收入与农村居民点内部收入不平等之间的关系。我们的研究结果凸显了CPR与农村收入关系的三个重要方面。首先，研究证实，即使在不同地理环境和CPR类型下，基于CPR的收入在农村贫困人口收入中占据重要份额。低于世界银行每人每天1.9美元贫困线的家庭，平均约有四分之一的家庭收入来源于CPR。其次，回归结果强调了物质资源丰富度和社会可及性、家庭人口特征、区域人口/市场背景，以及最为关键的家庭所拥有的互补性生产资产在从CPR获取收入中的重要性。第三，CPR收获技术的广泛性质与收入不平等之间存在显著相关性：当收获技术为资本密集型时，较富裕的家庭从CPR中获得的货币收益更多，不仅在绝对数额上，而且在家庭收入占比上也是如此，从而导致此类CPR加剧了居民点内部的不平等。我们的研究结果强调了将CPR的多样性、可用性、获取途径和技术背景纳入CPR研究的重要性，同时也凸显了制定有利于贫困人口政策的必要性，这些政策不仅要确保资源获取，还要支持贫困人口获得技术和市场准入。
title: How do common pool natural resources relate to rural income, poverty and inequality? A multi-country assessment
title_zh: 共同资源性自然资源与农村收入、贫困和不平等的关系：一项跨国评估

abstract: Since 2010, a growing proportion of doctoral graduates have been taking jobs outside academia. This column explores where elite early-career economists work, using a dataset covering all PhD graduates from US economics programmes. The findings revealt that recent elite PhD graduates are more likely to leave academia, to take jobs outside the US, and to be absorbed by a tech sector that draws broadly across gender, ethnicity, and programme prestige. However, East Asian candidates continue to face a substantial penalty in access to top academic positions. Within academia, elite advisor networks continue to confer advantages, reinforcing stratification at the top.
abstract_zh: 自2010年以来，越来越多的博士毕业生选择在学术界之外就业。本文利用涵盖美国经济学项目所有博士毕业生的数据集，探讨了精英早期职业经济学家的就业去向。研究发现，近年来，精英博士毕业生更倾向于离开学术界，前往美国以外地区工作，并被科技行业广泛吸纳，这一趋势跨越了性别、种族及项目声望的界限。然而，东亚候选人在获取顶尖学术职位方面仍面临显著劣势。在学术界内部，精英导师网络持续带来优势，加剧了顶层的分层现象。
authors: Markus Eberhardt, Giovanni Facchini, Valeria Rueda
title: Expanding opportunities: Economics PhD placement in the 21st century
title_zh: 扩大机会：21世纪经济学博士就业去向

abstract: This paper studies robust mechanism design in bilateral trade under limited information. I introduce a new class of mechanisms in which the buyer and seller submit a bid and an ask, and trade occurs when the bid–ask difference exceeds a random spread drawn from a publicly known distribution. Conditional on trade, the asset is sold at the midpoint price, and each trader pays the same commission, which depends on the bid–ask difference through a function determined by the random spread distribution. I show that these mechanisms, termed generalized double auctions, are strategy-proof and include both welfare-guarantee-maximizing and profit-guarantee-maximizing mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了信息有限条件下双边贸易中的稳健机制设计。我引入了一类新型机制，其中买方和卖方分别提交出价与要价，当买卖价差超过一个由公开已知分布随机抽取的价差时，交易发生。在交易条件下，资产以中间价出售，每位交易者支付相同的佣金，该佣金通过由随机价差分布决定的函数依赖于买卖价差。我证明，这些被称为广义双重拍卖的机制是策略-proof的，并包含了最大化福利保障和最大化利润保障的机制。
title: Generalized Double Auctions: Maximizing Welfare Guarantees in Bilateral Trade
title_zh: 广义双重拍卖：双边贸易中福利保障的最大化
